{{Quote|Captain Cohl's freighter has been found. The Corellian freighter. Ten customs agents were found tied up in the rear cabin.|Saesee Tiin|<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
This '''starship''' was a beat-up [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] provided by the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] to the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Arwen Cohl]] for his mission to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] during the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]]<ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> 

Cohl took possession of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] at [[Docking Bay 331]] in [[Karfeddion Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karfeddion]], where he was recruiting other mercenaries to aid in his mission. [[Rella]], his lover, commanded the ship when it was boarded by  [[Customs official/Legends|customs officials]] from the [[Eriadu Customs and Immigration]] for an inspection before landing on the planet. Rella and the other mercenaries easily captured the officials and forced their [[Unidentified female chief customs inspector|chief inspector]] to order the rest of her team to board the freighter from their [[picket ship]], leading to all of them being captured.<ref name="CoD" />

Before the trade summit could begin on the planet, security officials found the freighter and the ten customs officials tied up in the rear cabin.<ref name="CoD" />
